security_applicability: applicable: the phase adds a Node script that parses argv, builds paths, dynamically imports modules by path, reads a binary GLB, and writes a JSON record; hostile-input probing is required and was done
summary: No blocking findings. The measurement script behaves correctly on every normal and missing-input path (exit 1 with the named error before any import, no hang on a truncated GLB, no wrong measure.json). Three local-only hardening items: --asset is not validated with the checkAssetName rules, so a traversal name escapes the repo for reads and the dynamic import executes the out-of-repo module (probe marker printed); the measure.json write follows a pre-planted symlink; a corrupt GLB prints a raw multi-line stack. Each needs a hostile local file or argument, so no normal run reaches a wrong result; all three are tech-debt.
nonblocking_findings: N1 [Tech-debt] review-b: scripts/proportion-check.mjs never validates --asset with the checkAssetName rules that src/pipeline.ts:33 exports and the forge CLI enforces. A traversal name (six '../' segments) passes all existence checks, reads assets/, out/, stats.json, and the GLB outside the repository, and the dynamic import() at scripts/proportion-check.mjs:904 executes the target module's top-level code: my probe .ts in /tmp printed P4_PROBE_IMPORT_EXECUTED before the script failed on the truncated GLB. The measure.json write path (scripts/proportion-check.mjs:1069) is fixed and cannot traverse. Reaching this needs a hostile argument or a hostile local file, and the operator supplies the argument, so no normal run is affected; fix by calling checkAssetName (or the same three rules) in parseArgs.

N2 [Tech-debt] review-b: the measure.json write follows a pre-planted symlink: with out/chibi-sprouts/redesign/measure.json symlinked to a temp file, a normal run of `./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/proportion-check.mjs --asset sprout-mom-kim` overwrote the target with the record (probe target contained the full measure.json content after the run; symlink intact). Local-writer only, the same class the Phase 2 review accepted for the forge CLI (review-b-p2 N2); scripts/proportion-check.mjs:1071 uses plain writeFileSync with no exclusive create.

N3 [Tech-debt] review-b: a truncated GLB fails safe but noisily: readGlb (scripts/proportion-check.mjs:725) throws a RangeError and the top-level handler prints a multi-line stack, not one named error line. Exit is 1, there is no hang, and the write at line 1071 never runs, so no wrong result; consider catching parse errors into the `asset <name>: not built`-style one-line format.
